notes.title: 2.2.1 Hot Fix
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/aaba2161c54c637118c651135c080f56e2fbcc45.png"][/img][/p][p]Update 2.2.1 fixes several issues that could interrupt multiplayer games and adds additional logging to help diagnose an issue causing some players to disconnect unexpectedly. The fixes included in today’s patch are thanks to your feedback, so please continue to report any issues to us at [url="https://help.relic.com"]help.relic.com[/url]. [/p][h3][b]General[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing players from creating matches when launching from GOG Galaxy  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an error that would lead to a crash when transferring badges in Multiplayer [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added additional logging to better diagnose the following rare issue. If you continue to encounter this issue, please submit a new support request at [url="https://help.relic.com"]help.relic.com[/url][/p][p]>Multiplayer sessions disconnect seconds after loading is complete[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2.2.0 Update Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/7e78852b20b36c3a0b14e7767e9418596853385d.png"][/img][/p][p]Update 2.2.0 resolves issues across several categories including gameplay, multiplayer, U.I., art and animation, modding, and hotkeys. We have also included additional logging to provide our team with better data as we work to improve stability and automatch. Many of the fixes included in today’s patch are thanks to your feedback, so please continue to report any issues to us at [url="https://help.relic.com/"]help.relic.com[/url].  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]General[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Added additional logging to better diagnose the following rare issues. If you continue to encounter these issues, please submit a new support request at [url="https://help.relic.com"]help.relic.com[/url] :[/p][list][*][p]Crashes during badge transfer when starting a Multiplayer match [/p][/*][*][p]The game video output freezing before, during, or immediately following the intro videos [/p][/*][*][p]Desync errors during multiplayer gameplay [/p][/*][*][p]Audio being played through the incorrect device or not playing at all  [/p][/*][*][p]Automatch immediately cancelling when attempting to find a game [/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer is greyed out and unavailable [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a font issue that was preventing some Polish alphabet characters from correctly displaying in Dark Crusade [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Windowed Mode – Windowed mode now correctly displays the window borders when the game resolution matches the monitor’s resolution setting [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Save/Load - Updated Autosave to remove noticeable hitch [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Audio – Updated audio initialization to fix several cases where players did not receive audio output from the game [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Gameplay[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]In Dark Crusade and Soul Storm campaigns, Honor Guard units are no longer counted as lost if they joined a squad during a scripted mission[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Skirmish A.I. – updated the A.I. build logic to improve cases where the A.I. would stop creating new buildings and updated worker logic to reduce how many builders are sent to under construction resource buildings [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sisters of Battle – Updated squad cap increase for the final research step from 3 to 4 and removed Repentia Mistress and Imagifier squad cap modifiers [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dawn of War – Fixed terrain in Mission 1 that allows enemy units to spawn inside cranes [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dawn of War – Fixed scripting issues in Mission 2 that could cause the objectives to not be cleared correctly and prevent the mission from ending  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Winter Assault – Fixed a scripting error that could cause the mission to not end without completing all sub-objectives in Order Mission 2 [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Winter Assault – Updated terrain that was blocking troops from leaving the Field Command building without a rally point in Order Mission 2 [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Winter Assault – Fixed terrain with incorrect impasse that could cause the Squiggoth to become stuck [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Winter Assault – Fixed sky rotation in Disorder Mission 4 [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dark Crusade – Updated Imperial Guard Governor Raiment’s Wargear to correctly allow popcap to increase beyond 20 [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Soulstorm – Updated dialogue in Tau & Space Marine stronghold missions to avoid missing English dialogue [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Capture Points – Updated capture points to be match legacy behavior of visibility in the shroud (dark black undiscovered territory in scripted missions) and fog of war [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]Multiplayer[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a configuration issue in Automatch that changed all player colors and banners to the default settings. Players will now be able to use their custom Army Painter designs in Automatch as intended, as long as they have been set in the Army Painter.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed the ability for Hosts to kick players during the countdown  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added a warning when attempting to use Auto Teams with a closed slot – this was resulting in unwanted A.I. being added to balance player counts [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Dawn of War - Definitive Edition API to show automatch rankings for players.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]User Interface[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Multiplayer – Join Game page now correctly displays game info when selecting a game to join [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Multiplayer – Fixed font error causing missing text when viewing the map name for Custom games [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Multiplayer – Updated player statistics to correctly show game count and properly display ratings [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Soulstorm – Territory icons now display at the correct resolution [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Soulstorm – Updated unit icons to be the correct size [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Army Painter – Fixed an issue that was causing custom badges & banners to appear as pink squares [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Loading Screens – Updated Dark Crusade & Soulstorm loading screen text to be more legible [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Loading Screens – Winter Assault loading screen art updated to support widescreen  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Simplified Chinese – Fixed several punctuation errors that caused English characters to be displayed in narrative text [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]Art & Animation[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]All – Force Commanders badges now display at the correct scale and resolution [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]All – Updated all capture point banners to display at the correct resolution [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]All – Fixed artifacting on the Relic capture points [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Space Marines – Sacred Artifact building no longer shows construction FX after completion [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Space Marines – Armory doors correctly animate when performing research [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Space Marines – Updated Librarian walk animations to be in sync with movement speed [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Space Marines – Eye lens color updated to be consistent in Dark Crusade & Soulstorm [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Space Marines – Fixed placement of glowing skull on upgraded Assault Marines [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Eldar – Ulthwe now use the same team color values in Winter Assault as in later games [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Chaos – Fixed an animation issue causing Raptors flamethrower weapons FX to shoot at an angle [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Chaos – Fixed Aspiring Champion’s banner that was mirrored [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Chaos – Daemon Prince now uses correct team colors in Skirmish / Multiplayer [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Chaos – Sorcerer animations updated to fire correctly when moving and shooting [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Imperial Guard – Updated General Sturnn’s lightning claws to be correctly attached and oriented [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Imperial Guard – Updated Commander’s sync kill animation to correctly attach guns to his hands [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Imperial Guard – Updated animations for Heavy Weapons team to correctly rotate and trigger death animations [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sisters of Battle – Fixed a naming error with the Veteran Superior that prevented the whole model from rendering [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dark Eldar – Fixed a texture error making the Tower of Loathing appear black when upgraded [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dark Eldar – Fixed a Wych animation bug that would cause units to appear stun-locked when melee attacked by a unit that does not typically apply a stun effect [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Dark Eldar – Soulstorm campaign now uses the correct team colors by default [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Orks – Updated Waaagh! Banner gunner animations to be correctly animated [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tau – Updated FX on Crisis Suit missiles to be correctly synced [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tau – Fixed an error on the Commander that caused tracers to fire straight up in Dark Crusade [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tau – Fixed an issue causing Tau Commander’s missiles to appear facing backwards [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tau – Fixed a case where the Dark Crusade commander would use Soulstorm Wargear [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Necrons – Updated materials on Necron Immortals to appear more metallic [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Necrons – Updated base buildings to have higher resolution terrain detail [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tutorial – Terrain updated to improve clarity on which areas are walkable and which are out of bounds [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]Modding[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Audio – Fixed a crash that occurred when the game tried to read a modded audio file with a ‘.’ character in the file name [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mission Editor – fixed an issue that would prevent Undo from functioning dragging to paint [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mission Editor – updated Heightmap Editor to regenerate and align decals after modifying terrain heights [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Water – Legacy modded maps that used the old water system for non-water (ex. lava) now retain their non-reflective state [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]UI – Added scrollbars to faction selection, win conditions, and other scrollable lists to better support mods that add numerous options [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]UI – Added functionality to support showing Mods, Options, and Credits selectable in the Main Menu when a mod is loaded [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Scar Doc - SCAR stands for "Scripting at Relic.” SCAR documentation is installed to “Tools\\ScarDoc.” To launch the documentation from this folder, open "frameset.htm” in a browser. (If the sidebar menu is not shown, click the “No Javascript?” link.) In the “Scar” section from the sidebar menu is an overview of the SCAR system and some tutorials with sample code. The SCAR API is detailed below the “Blueprints” and “Functions” sections. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]Hotkeys[/b] [/h2][h3][b]General[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]The lua files associated with each keybinding option now contain details of the changes from the previous version to help improve the ability of modders to update their own custom options [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed unload command to Ctrl+F1 for Gridkeys. This command is in different places in different cases, so can't be on the grid[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Space Marines[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Moved Rallying Cry, Inquisition, and Frag Grenades to middle row positions to allow for consistent positions [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated grid keys for Rhino smoke launchers and Skull Probe Sabotage  [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Chaos[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Rearranged Cultist weapons so their upgrades would better match positions in the Chaos Marine Squad (plasma gun upgrades in same position so grid keys match) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Moved Frag Grenades to right column and Berzerker Rage to middle row to prevent spacing conflicts [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Moved Tainted Auspex to bottom of row 3 [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated grid keys for Frage Grenades, Berzerker Rage, Smoke Launchers, Tainted Auspex and Speed Fiends to match grid positions [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Orks[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Changed Slugga Boy Burna and Killa Kan Rokkit Launch weapon upgrade gridkeys to match grid position [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed Fightin Juice ability to position 2 and gridkey to X to match grid position [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Eldar[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Corrected webway_gate_healing_research binding (was eldar_webway_gate_healing_research) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Moved Nightwing to middle row and updated gridkey to match [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed Eldritch Storm grid keys to Ctrl+V to accommodate duplication when Farseer is attached [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed Embolden to grid keys Ctrl+C to accommodate duplication when Farseer is attached, changed to position 3 to reduce conflicts [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed Entanglement to bottom right and changed gridkey V to match revised grid position, changed to position 4 to reduce conflicts [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed plasma grenade and banshee warshout to middle row to avoid conflicts with attached Farseer [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Imperial Guard[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Changed Commissar's execute to position 2 to avoid position conflicts and updated gridkey to match revised grid position [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed priests Fanatical to position 2, and psyker abilities to 3, 4, 5 to avoid conflicts with General in command squad and with Kasrkin when attached[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed Heavy Weapons Team weapon upgrades gridkeys  to match grid position [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Necrons[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Changed tomb spyder harvest gridkey to match grid position [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added binding for second Obelisk add on to allow for a key that matches grid position [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated grid keys for Necron Lord abilities necron_mass_resurrection, necron_solar_pulse, lightning_field changed to Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+X, Ctrl+C to avoid clashes (Necron Lord can equip 3/6 active abilities so consistant grid position is not possible) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed duplicate entry for necron_solar_pulse [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Sisters of Battle[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Vehicle armor research moved to middle row to avoid conflicts with laud hailers and changed gridkey to match grid postion [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ardent Flame gridkey moved to match grid position [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Krak Grenades, Phosphor Grenades, and Fervor moved to middle row and set gridkey to match revised grid position, to avoid conflicts with attached leaders [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dark Eldar[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]set dark_eldar_upgrade_commander_health, dark_eldar_combat_drugs, dark_eldar_tame_warp_beasts, and dark_eldar_terrorfex gridkeys to W to match grid position [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Tau[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Created consistent position for Tau Energy Shield [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new bindings for Tau Commander's campaign wargear drones (tau_commander_shield_drone and tau_commander_sp_drone) to prevent conflicts and accommodate grid positions. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated grid keys for Energy Shield, Ion Shield, and Harbinger Direct Spawn to match grid positions [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]As a reminder, [url="https://help.relic.com/hc/en-us/articles/44152746678803-Customizing-Hotkeys-in-Warhammer-40-000-Dawn-of-War-Definitive-Edition"][u]here is our guide on customizing hotkeys[/u][/url] in Dawn of War – Definitive Edition. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]High Priority Known Issues – Targeting Late September [/h2][p]The team at Relic is constantly reviewing issues reported by the community and adjusting priorities to address the most frequently occurring issues. [/p][p]Thank you for all your submissions to [url="https://help.relic.com"]help.relic.com[/url] ! [/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]General[/i][/b] [/h3][list][*][p][i]Army Painter – visible artifacts when team colors overlap on several models[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Performance – framerate can drop significantly during combat in larger scale games[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]UI – the cursor prompt to enter text (ex. When creating a Profile, naming a Save file, or the Chat box in Multiplayer) may not appear[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Profiles – Cloud saves do not contain profile data when switching between devices which blocks the ability to create a new profile without an error message[/i] [/p][/*][/list][h3][i][b]Gameplay[/b][/i] [/h3][list][*][p][i]Units with a Jump ability can appear to start/complete the jump then teleport back to the starting location[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Disembarking a squad from a transport vehicle in narrow space can cause units to be spawned out of bounds and become stuck[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Ork Gretchins can fail to move to complete their next build order when shift-queuing after building a mine field[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Faction-specific resources are split among all allies when Resource Sharing is enabled when the ally is a different faction that cannot use that resource[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Sisters of Battle and Dark Eldar units do not play 3D audio correctly when using a zoomed out / modded camera[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Using the Deep Strike feature in the Soulstorm campaign can result in the units silently dying when summoned[/i] [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2]Additional Known Issues [/h2][p]The following are game impacting known issues that the development team is reviewing potential solutions for: [/p][list][*][p][i]HUD – An Eldar Farseer with all abilities unlocked that is attached to a Guardian squad will have some abilities become unavailable due to the command card running out of slots[/i][/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]We plan to release another patch in late September, so please continue to report any issues to [url="https://help.relic.com"]help.relic.com[/url] so that our team can triage and log issues accordingly. Be sure to join our [u][url="https://discord.gg/relicentertainment"]official Discord[/url][/u] to leave any additional feedback and to chat with other players and the development team. [/p]

notes.title: 2.1.1 Hot Fix
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/cf556db29babd424138b358581447ba317aab5c8.png"][/img][/p][p]Today’s 2.1.1 Hot Fix addresses a crash that occurred when booting [i]Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Definitive Edition[/i] via Steam in Offline mode introduced in this week’s 2.1.0 update. [/p][p]After this update, if you are still seeing crashes on start-up, please take the time to submit your information to BugSplat and, after submitting, wait a moment for the BugSplat website to load and review any troubleshooting steps that may be available.  These are targeted responses that can include more information and workarounds related to the issue encountered. [/p][p]A huge thank you to all our players that have been diligently reporting issues via our help portal as this is an essential tool for helping the team at Relic set priorities as we continue to support the game – please continue to do so at [url="https://help.relic.com/"]https://help.relic.com/[/url][/p][p][b]General[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a login error that would lead to a crash on start-up when launching the game in Offline mode on Steam [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 2.1.0 Update Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/f4b6275725472cd3ce5db8520cd655226709982e.png"][/img][/p][p]Today’s 2.1.0 Update addresses issues including cases where the cursor would fail to stay locked to the game, unit pathing issues where large vehicles, such as Dreadnoughts, could become stuck, and brings improvements to hotkey modding and WASD camera controls. Please refer to the help article "[url="https://help.relic.com/hc/en-us/articles/44152746678803-Customizing-Hotkeys-in-Warhammer-40-000-Dawn-of-War-Definitive-Edition"]Customizing Hotkeys in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition[/url]" for a step-by-step guide to customizing hotkeys. [/p][p]Additionally, this patch continues to address some of the highest occurring crashes, progression blockers and multiplayer issues, along with other art, animation, UI, and gameplay issues.  [/p][p]A huge thank you to all our players that have been diligently reporting issues via our help portal – please continue to do so at [url="https://help.relic.com/"]https://help.relic.com/[/url][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]General[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed numerous cases where Lock Cursor to Game would fail to stay locked (for example, when receiving platform notifications or after Alt+Tabbing) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed several crashes that could occur while custom badges were transferring while loading into a Multiplayer game [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an error where Windows could detect the game was unresponsive during longer loading times for large scale Multiplayer games [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed two rare crashes that could occur when loading a menu screen [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed several errors that would prevent Automatch from correctly finding matches [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed several causes of desync errors in Multiplayer that could lead to a crash when leaving the match or on match end [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed rare cases where certain players would be able to load into the game without a player profile – this would lead to errors when attempting to play Multiplayer or when saving the game [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Character speech now correctly plays when the game language is set to Russian [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new troubleshooting steps to BugSplat for those that crash on launch. If you are still having issues, please follow the links in the BugSplat window [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added additional messaging & logging to help diagnose certain players being unable to connect to the RLink servers and seeing the Multiplayer option greyed out. After the update, if you are still seeing this issue, please submit a new request at [url="https://help.relic.com"]help.relic.com[/url] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Multiplayer[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Disabled Resource Sharing by default during Automatch [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed Fortress (3 Player) from the Automatch map pool [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Gameplay[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an exploit where too many resources are refunded when cancelling buildings under construction[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cases where large vehicles, such as Dreadnoughts, could become stuck in cliffs when multiple units were pathing at the same time and stopped in the same location [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed pathing issues when units with a melee charge attack, such as Kroot Carnivores, could become stuck when attempting to charge an enemy unit above them [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where infantry units would be frozen in place for several seconds when pathing alongside friendly vehicles [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a data error that was causing Space Marine Force Commander and Imperial General to use voices that did not match their unit [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an error that could cause mission dialogue to not correctly trigger or to skip lines during scripted sequences [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a frequently playing sound effect for Tau Barracudas [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed several issues where keybindings overlapped, such as Ecclesiarchal Chapel, Haemonculus’ Laboratory, and Techpriests [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated Winter Assault Order Mission 2 to prevent hidden Chaos units from triggering a fail condition while the player is focused on the Eldar segment of the mission [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Winter Assault Order Mission 2 that prevented units from spawning from the Field Command building without a rally point being set [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated melee-killed infantry corpses to match the persistence of ranged-killed units [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added unit occlusion to the Sisters of Battle and Dark Eldar buildings [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]User Interface[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]On ultrawide monitors, fixed the alignment of the error popup when attempting to perform an action without the required resources [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed several cases that would cause hotkeys to not be displayed on the HUD [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]WASD Camera & Controls[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Set secondary camera move to SHIFT+WASD on all keybind sets (except AZERTY grid where it is the equivalent, SHIFT+ZQSD); arrow keys continue to also work [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Copies of the keybind lua files are now copied to the user's /Profile/Profile\[#]/ directory for easier modding without unpacking an archive [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added AZERTY and QWERTZ versions of Gridkeys (these are selectable by any player who wishes to, regardless of region) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new keybindings for Sniper Rifle Research (Space Marines) and command squad versions of Commissar, Psyker and Priest (IG) and bound those to proper grid positions; in non-grid keybinds these are generally duplicates of the previous bindings. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In gridkeys, set melee stance to F (its grid position) and combat stance to F1 (which is off the grid but near at hand) -- this key appears in different positions based on if a squad or building is selected so can't have a proper grid position [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In gridkeys, shifted the advanced stance buttons along the function keys to make room for F1 use [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In gridkeys, changed the Dark Eldar global abilities to be on Alt+\[key] to free up Shift+WASD for camera movement [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In gridkeys, moved options menu to Escape [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]Art & Animation[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed alignment of glowing eyes on Necron Warriors [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed alignment of the glowing skull on Space Marines & Assault Marines when the Bionic Upgrade is applied [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated Space Marine Dreadnought and Terminator so assault cannon barrels correctly rotate when firing [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the Space Marine Force Commander not aiming correctly at enemy targets [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed cases where Thunderhawk engine lights were still visible in the sky at certain angles after constructing Space Marine buildings [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated the Veteran Superior Sister of Battle to correctly load the entire model [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed animation stutters/pauses that could occur when spamming movement commands to units (ex. Dark Eldar Hellion Squad) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed flickering on the Space Marine Stronghold building [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed stuttering animations on units with melee charge attacks when the path to attack is blocked [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed animation of the Kroot Hounds to prevent them from appearing to teleport [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed occasional T-Pose on idle animation for Chaos Aspiring Champion [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed posing for Orks that are in cover but out of combat [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the Ork Pile O Gunz turret to correctly aim at targets [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed several issues across maps where there were noticeable seams between terrain textures [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Modding[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Mods that have legacy UI images (ex. Unit Portraits) will now be able to correctly replace the Definitive Edition updated assets [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added support to access linear campaigns with mods based on Dark Crusade or Soulstorm if the mod’s .module file includes “DXP2”-like sub-module. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Example mods: “Ultimate Apocalypse”, “Tartarus, Lorn V, Kronus and Kaurava Campaigns for Soulstorm”, and others built in the same manner[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated the Army Painter to not have misaligned text when using legacy mods that reskinned the screen [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mods that are packaged with additional mods inside of them will no longer fail to open if the secondary mod is marked as having a dependency that is not included [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a rare crash in the MissionEditor when attempting to save a modded map [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an error when the ObjectEditor was unable to open EBP files because it could not find the BurnerImp executable [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Note: ObjectEditor needs to be launched in the mod directory (where your pipeline.ini files is), but with the command line -appDir <installdir> so it can find the BurnerImp.[/i] [/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]High Priority Known Issues – Targeting September [/h3][p][/p][p]While the issues below are not fixed in today’s update, we will be aiming to resolve these in the upcoming September patches. This list is not exhaustive; however, it is provided to highlight the major issues that the team will be targeting to improve. Thanks again to everyone who has submitted reports and feedback as we work to improve the game. [/p][p][/p][h3]General [/h3][list][*][p][i]Occasional network error that can lead to a crash when post-game results are being calculated[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]Game settings are not displayed when browsing Custom Games[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]Map names are displayed as missing symbols when playing in Russian / Chinese while the host is in another language[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]Gridkeys do not correctly load when playing in Automatch[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]Army Painter colors are not used when playing Automatch[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]Squads with a jump or teleport attack can appear to partially complete[u],[/u] then teleport back to the starting location[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]For some players the game audio does not correctly play from the default audio device[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]Capture points (ex. Strategic Points) are not visible in the shroud[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]Units do not correctly unload from the Dark Eldar Raider[/i] [/p][/*][*][p][i]testStats.lua is not correctly being written on match end[/i] [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Additional Patches [/h2][p][/p][p]This is an overview of our next two patches. However, please note that overall stability for the game is our priority and that may delay some of these items. [/p][p][/p][h3]Patch 2 – Modding – Target: Early September [/h3][list][*][p]Improved modding documentation based on frequently asked questions and a sample mod [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional support to ensure stability of mod usage [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Patch 3 – Additional Reported Issues – Target: Late September [/h3][list][*][p]Gameplay exploits – targeted fixes for issues affecting Multiplayer [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Unit Portraits – newly recaptured unit portraits using the Definitive Edition models for all units [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix 2.0.1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/31234179d4fb5692ae3ec6213605d6de62829002.png"][/img][/p][p]Today’s hot fix aims to resolve some of the highest occurring crashes, progression blockers and multiplayer issues affecting players in [i]Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Definitive Edition[/i]. [/p][p]We will be releasing another patch next week with additional high-priority fixes. The fixes coming in next week’s patch required a bit more time to test and validate, so we appreciate everyone’s patience as we work on them. Thank you to all our players that have been diligently reporting issues via our help portal – please continue to do so at [url="https://help.relic.com/"]https://help.relic.com/[/url][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]General[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could not see Multiplayer game lobbies hosted by a player using a different audio language (English, German, French, and Russian) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented the game from loading the correct language using the GOG Galaxy launcher for those using Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a desync that led to a crash in Multiplayer games where players on Windows & Linux (SteamDeck / Proton) were playing together  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed two crashes that could occur during singleplayer or multiplayer when numerous enemy units were starting to move while the player is also moving the camera [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed two crashes that could occur when pre-rendered movies started for players using older operating systems. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur during loading screens or while saving the game [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a fatal scar error in Winter Assault Disorder Mission 1 when Gorgutz was killed immediately before a cut-scene triggered [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a scripting error that prevented Listening Posts from being buildable in Dawn of War Mission 1 when two strategic points were captured at the same time [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that could sometimes prevent objective locations from being correctly highlighted by arrow FX in Campaign missions [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Updated Gridkeys controls to fix a keybind conflict on Orks, Space Marines, and Imperial Guard [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]High Priority Issues – [u]Aiming to Resolve August 26th[/u] [/h2][p][/p][p][b][u]The below issues are not fixed in today's patch[/u][/b]. We aim to resolve these in next week's patch which should release on Tuesday, August 26th. We feel it is important to share these details so that players are aware of our goals for the coming week. Thanks again for your patience and continued reports as we work to improve the game.[/p][list][*][p][i]Two possible crashes when custom badge transfer fails while loading into Multiplayer matches. The crash can lead to all other players having an infinite loading screen that will eventually crash [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Rare error where new players are not able to create / load a profile name and receive errors when attempting to start missions / multiplayer [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Rare crash that can occur on a loading screen when entering Campaign Missions [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Rare crash at the end of Multiplayer matches when the Results screen is shown[/i] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Additional error logging for players who cannot start or consistently time out when trying to connect to Multiplayer – this will provide us with more data as we work to resolve this issue [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Dialogue occasionally does not trigger in the correct sequence during campaign missions – some lines can be skipped [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Large units – such a Dreadnoughts - can get stuck when navigating near other large units beside cliffs [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Infantry units can become stunned for too long of a period when pathfinding near vehicles [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Infantry with a charge attack can get stuck pathfinding when attempting to charge on an elevated position [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Cursor lock functionality does not stay locked when the game loses focus (using Windows key, Alt+Tab, getting Steam/GOG notifications) [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Camera movement keys cannot be remapped by modders [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Keybinds are not easily accessible for modders without having to unpack an archive [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Update loading order to allow mods to overwrite unit portraits [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Rare crash in the Mission Editor when attempting to save changes to a map [/i][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Mods that package multiple mods fail to load if a secondary mod is marked as having a dependency that is not included[/i] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Additional Patches[/h2][p][/p][h3]Patch 2 – Modding – Target: Early September[/h3][list][*][p]Update file load order to allow for additional customization of the User Interface[/p][/*][*][p]Improved modding documentation based on frequently asked questions and a sample mod[/p][/*][*][p]Additional support to ensure stability of mod usage[/p][/*][/list][h3]Patch 3 – Additional Reported Issues – Target: Late September[/h3][list][*][p]Gameplay exploits – targeted fixes for issues affecting Multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Unit Portraits – newly recaptured unit portraits using the Definitive Edition models for all units[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Definitive Edition Out Now
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/8e91adaa3eaeffe2fb15bb8198ad1f8f9826d584.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556750/Warhammer_40000_Dawn_of_War__Definitive_Edition/"][i]Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Definitive Edition is out now![/i][/url][/u] [/h3][p][/p][p]Experience this genre-defining Warhammer 40,000 classic in all its blood-soaked glory, including four complete campaigns, nine classically depicted factions, and over 100 skirmish maps – all in one game. [/p][p][/p][p]Developed by Relic Entertainment, this is the iconic Dawn of War as players remember it, optimized for modern hardware. The award-winning real-time strategy game has been improved and enhanced while remaining faithful to the grimdark original.  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8xFKCaztKIA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b][i]So, what is included in the Definitive Edition? [/i][/b] [/h3][h3][b]Everything – all in one game![/b] [/h3][p][/p][p][b]Nine full factions from across the galaxy, classically depicted[/b] [/p][list][*][p]The transhuman warriors of the [b]Space Marines[/b] bring the Emperor’s fury from orbit. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The savage [b]Orks[/b] smash through all their foes with abandon.   [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The mystical [b]Eldar[/b] strike from hiding with weapons of incomparable elegance.   [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The twisted force of [b]Chaos[/b] marries the power of daemons and heretic Space Marines alike.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The mechanized [b]Imperial Guard[/b] roll their mighty tanks across the battlefield.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The high-tech [b]Tau[/b] deploy powerful mechanized battle suits and fearsome Kroot warriors.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The ancient [b]Necrons[/b] rise from the sands to eliminate all life.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The foul [b]Dark Eldar[/b] swoop from the skies to steal away their victims.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The pious [b]Sisters of Battle[/b] purge the foes of mankind without mercy. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Four Full Campaigns [/b] [/p][list][*][p]Command the Blood Ravens as they face the deadly fall of Tartarus in the original [b]Dawn of War campaign[/b].  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lead the [b]Winter Assault[/b] on Lorn V, guiding either the forces of Order (Imperial Guard and Eldar) or Disorder (Orks and Chaos) in a race to recover a mighty Titan war machine.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Conquer the planet Kronus during the [b]Dark Crusade[/b], a non-linear strategic campaign playable as classic Space Marines, Imperial Guard, Eldar, Orks, Chaos, Tau, or Necrons.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weather the [b]Soulstorm[/b] in the Kaurava System, in a second non-linear campaign, this time playable as any of the nine factions. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Frantic Multiplayer[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Play 2 to 8 player multiplayer, either in teams or in free-for-all automatch [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Choose from many modes and numerous maps. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Take control of the action in Custom Games and set your own rules for war [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Solo Skirmish[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Play as your favorite army in solo skirmish to dominate the enemy A.I. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fully customize match settings  [/p][/*][*][p]Pick from over 100 maps [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/a1b872b3ee27c48f77aa92dbbb6cb5cb9bd3ef88.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/1305061407b0411565f217449d5271659ecbd44c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/7ef2b9902ab92836e09b7b2a5337ba4d2001d602.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/93f5c888d14aa37ad41b1f30a39fe99bdafdfc5e.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3][b]What’s new and improved?[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Full 4K resolution Upgraded unit and world textures – 4x the originals [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Upgraded from x32-bit to x64-bit platform [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Compatible with 20-years of lovingly crafted mods  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Includes Classic Hotkeys, Grid Hotkeys and Modern Hotkeys presets [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Image based lighting enables a higher level of fidelity, while retaining the classic experience [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved world lighting, unit reflections, improved shadows, new unit gloss and emissive lighting will faithfully enhance the game [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved gameplay camera shows the battlefield like never before   [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increased draw distance allows for a more cinematic experience [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]HUD and screen layout optimized for modern resolutions [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Widescreen support (up to 21:9 fully supported – note that wider resolutions will work, though they may see some discrepancies from standard resolutions – please let us know if you encounter any issues!)   [/p][/*][/list][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/031d1ab94c70794dc4c171646c58d9b5954707c0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/f8d37f82d77b76037b604d67bf0dccdca299e07b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/fbd547e6ac804c17126a2a86bdea9477d7cc3f8c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/65c40d86eb4a58ff78272fbe361d67fe1e6a3d48.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3][b]Post Launch[/b] [/h3][p]While the game is available today, we are [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3556750/discussions/1/591779517900522135/"]continuing to fix bugs[/url] and make some additional improvements. We will also be monitoring the game’s performance across different hardware specifications to ensure it is running optimally. We aim to release any critical hot fixes as needed, with subsequent patches rolling out over the course of August & September 2025. Please note that these patches will not be focused on additional content or multiplayer balance changes, but on resolving or improving high priority bugs and features.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Play it today![/b] [/h3][p]New players can experience where this classic franchise began, and veterans can relive the magic of this seminal Warhammer 40,000 title. Be sure to join our [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/relicentertainment"]official Discord[/url][/u] to discuss the Definitive Edition and find others to play with, and if you’re encountering any technical problems or wish to report a bug, please [u][url="https://help.relic.com/hc/en-us"]submit a new request here[/url][/u]. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]GeForce NOW Support[/b][/h3][p]Dawn of War - Definitive Edition will be available via GeForce NOW on day one. GeForce NOW delivers the firepower needed to join the frontlines without having to wait for downloads or installs. Players can leap straight into battle, resume campaigns and join multiplayer chaos with just a few clicks. No frames lost to underpowered hardware — every skirmish, every decisive strike is rendered in full glory in the cloud.[/p][p][/p][h2]FAQ [/h2][p] [/p][p]Q: [b][i]What platforms will Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition be available for? [/i][/b] [/p][p]A: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition will be available for PC on [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556750/Warhammer_40000_Dawn_of_War__Definitive_Edition/"]Steam[/url][/u] and [url="https://www.gog.com/en/game/warhammer_40000_dawn_of_war_definitive_edition"][u]GOG[/u][/url] storefronts. The game can also be streamed via GeForce NOW.  [/p][p][/p][p]Q: [b][i]How much will Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition cost? [/i][/b] [/p][p]A: USD$29.99 [/p][p][/p][p]Q: [b][i]I own the Dawn of War – Anniversary Edition, do I get a discount? [/i][/b] [/p][p]A: Yes! There will be a 30% discount for players who own the Anniversary Edition on Steam or GOG.  [/p][p][/p][p]Q: [b][i]Is there cross play between the Steam and GOG versions of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition?[/i][/b][/p][p]A: Yes! Both platforms can play multiplayer together in any way (automatch, custom games, etc.) though players cannot use friend invites across platforms.[/p][p]   [/p][p]Q: [i][b]Is there cross play between the Definitive Edition and the Anniversary Edition (legacy)?[/b][/i][/p][p]A: There is no cross play between [i]Dawn of War: Definitive Edition [/i]and [i]Dawn of War: Anniversary Edition[/i] (legacy). These are different games with different code bases. Multiplayer in RTS games is deterministic - meaning the game has to occur in lockstep on every player's machine, and this isn't feasible due to improvements we have made, such as moving from a 32-bit to a 64-bit architecture or changes to improve pathfinding. [/p][p] [/p][p]Q: [b][i]Will you be adding any new content or post-launch DLC?[/i][/b] [/p][p]A: Our focus has been on delivering the ultimate Dawn of War experience – that means everything players know and love from the original game all in one package. Our primary goal has been to optimize Dawn of War for modern hardware; however, we are already planning additional patches to address high priority bugs and some legacy gameplay issues. [/p][p][/p][p]Q: [b][i]How do I use mods with Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition?[/i][/b][/p][p]A: We want to say a huge thank you to our community modders who we have been working with for many months. They've put in a lot of work both in helping us to support legacy mods, and in readying their own mods for the Definitive Edition. It is important to note that this is a different game with different tech from the Anniversary Edition. [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3556750/discussions/1/591779517900522091/"]Please read the following guide to understand how to use modded content in Dawn of War - Definitive Edition[/url]. Be sure to share any feedback you have about this guide to help improve it for other players, and we will adjust it accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p]Q: [b][i]Is there a Known Issues list with planned fixes?[/i][/b][/p][p]A: These are the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3556750/discussions/1/591779517900522135/"]Known Issues at launch[/url] that the team is targeting to improve during the course of August & September 2025. We will share updates letting you know when to expect hot fixes on our social channels @dawnofwar and on our [url="https://discord.gg/relicentertainment"]official Discord[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]Q:[b][i] How do I report an issue or get technical support?[/i][/b] 
A: For technical troubleshooting or support, please visit [url="https://help.relic.com"]help.relic.com[/url].[/p][p]  [/p][p]Q:[b][i] Where can I get more info or find others to play with?[/i][/b] [/p][p]A: The [u][url="https://discord.gg/relicentertainment"]Relic Entertainment Discord[/url][/u] server is a great place to stay up to date on any important information and to find other DoW fans to play with! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6cAhM1zzY1A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="9gV1AH4lga0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][previewyoutube="E9qOAHxAqbE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition Release Date Reveal
notes.content:
[h3]We’re excited to announce that [i]Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War – Definitive Edition[/i] will be released on August 14, 2025![/h3][p][/p][p]The Definitive Edition will be available to purchase that same day for USD$29.99. Players who already own the Dawn of War – Anniversary Edition will receive a 30% upgrade discount on Steam and GOG. This discount for previous owners will remain in place for the foreseeable future. The team has been hard at work updating this classic experience for modern hardware, but in the meantime, [url="https://youtu.be/pY_JzB0WxSA"]check out the classic Dawn of War trailer, newly enhanced in 4K[/url]![/p][p]  [/p][p]Q: [i][b]When is Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition coming out?[/b][/i] 
A: August 14, 2025 
 
Q: [i][b]What platforms will Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition be available for?[/b][/i] 
A: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition will be available for PC on the Steam and GOG storefronts. 
 
Q: [b][i]How much will Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition cost?[/i][/b]  [/p][p]A: USD$29.99[/p][p][/p][p]Q: [i][b]I own the Dawn of War – Anniversary Edition, do I get a discount?[/b][/i] [/p][p] A: Yes! There will be a 30% discount for players who own the Anniversary Edition on Steam or GOG.   [/p][p][/p][p]Q: [i][b]What languages will Dawn of War: Definitive Edition support?[/b][/i] [/p][p]A: Most of the original translations for the game will be available at launch with the addition of full text support for Simplified Chinese. We’ll have more news on all the language options for [i]Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition[/i] closer to its release date. [/p][p][/p][p]Q: [i][b]Is the minimum recommended specification on the Steam Store page accurate?[/b][/i] 
A: This is a conservative preliminary minimum specification. Further optimization during development will bring this down before launch. 
 
Q: [i][b]Will you be adding any new content or post-launch DLC?[/b][/i] 
A: No. Our focus is on delivering the ultimate Dawn of War experience when we launch the Definitive Edition later this year – that means everything players know and love from the original game all in one package. We’ll keep an eye out for any critical issues or bugs that need to be addressed after launch, but our primary goal is to optimize Dawn of War for modern hardware. 
 
Q: [i][b]Will you be making any multiplayer balance changes or quality of life improvements?[/b][/i] [/p][p]A: Though our primary focus is on updating the game for modern hardware, we have been keeping a close eye on your feedback. Multiplayer balance will mostly remain the same; however, we have been fixing some of the most egregious legacy bugs that should help improve the multiplayer experience. Though not all legacy bugs will be addressed for launch, we plan to be on standby to hot fix any high priority issues after the game’s official release. In addition to that, we are experimenting with changes to high impact items to improve general gameplay, such as the behavior of flying units or the pathing of infantry and vehicles, along with quality-of-life settings such as grid key presets.  
 [/p][p]Q: [i][b]Does this mean that we’ll also get a new version of Dawn of War 2 or any other Relic Entertainment games?[/b][/i] 
A: We can only talk about games that we have announced. Right now, we’re focused on supporting the Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition and our other released and upcoming Relic games. 
 
Q: [i][b]When will you share more information about the updates and improvements to the game?[/b][/i] 
A: In the lead up to our August launch, we have lots to share from the development team in blogs, videos, and livestreams. Join the official [url="https://www.discord.gg/relicentertainment"]Relic Entertainment Discord[/url] server to stay up to date on the latest. [/p]

notes.title: Announcing Dawn of War - Definitive Edition
notes.content:
“Cleanse, purge, kill!” [i]Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition[/i] is coming to PC later this year. Developed by Relic Entertainment, this is the iconic Dawn of War as players remember it, but optimized for modern hardware. The award winning and genre-defining classic real-time strategy game has been improved and enhanced while remaining faithful to the grimdark original.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/f73f196682a500dd8cef87b451d8776fbf9f1135.png[/img]

[b]So, what is included in the Definitive Edition?  [/b]
[list]
[*] Everything – all in one game! 
[*] 4 Classic Dawn of War Campaigns 
[*] 9 classically depicted Warhammer 40,000 Armies 
[*] Over 200 maps 
[/list]
[b]What’s new and improved? [/b]
[list]
[*] 4K and widescreen support 
[*] Upgraded unit and world textures – 4x the originals 
[*] Upgraded from x32-bit to x64-bit platform 
[*] Compatible with 20-years of lovingly crafted mods with better mod management in-game 
[*] Image based lighting enables a higher level of fidelity, while retaining the classic experience 
[*] Improved world lighting, unit reflections, improved shadows, new unit gloss and emissive lighting will faithfully enhance the game 
[*] Improved gameplay camera shows the battlefield like never before   
[*] Increased draw distance allows for a more cinematic experience 
[*] HUD and screen layout optimized for wide screen viewing 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/57ba298aaa23d0bc6231578de8425138bb39efe8.png[/img]

New players can experience where this classic franchise began, and veterans can relive the magic of this seminal Warhammer 40,000 title. 

[i]Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition[/i] will be releasing later this year for PC on both Steam and GOG. Wishlist it today! 

Be sure to follow our social channels linked below to stay up to date on the latest news and announcements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629844/1093d1ba734bcc7b7abd41ac93c59560571fde3e.png[/img]

[h2]FAQ [/h2]

Q: [i][b]When is Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition[i][/i] coming out? [/b][/i]
A: We are targeting a release later this year in 2025. 

Q: [i][b]What platforms will Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition be available for? [/b][/i]
A: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition will be available for PC on the Steam and GOG storefronts. 

Q: [i][b]How much will Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition cost? [/b][/i]
A: We don’t have a final price just yet but will announce this soon.  

Q: [i][b]What languages will Dawn of War: Definitive Edition support? [/b][/i]
A: We’ll have more news on all the language options for [i]Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition[/i] closer to its release date. 

Q: [i][b]Is the minimum recommended specification on the Steam Store page accurate? [/b][/i]
A: This is a conservative preliminary minimum specification. Further optimization during development will bring this down before launch. 

Q: [i][b]Will you be adding any new content or post-launch DLC? [/b][/i]
A: No. Our focus is on delivering the ultimate Dawn of War experience when we launch the Definitive Edition later this year – that means everything players know and love from the original game all in one package. We’ll keep an eye out for any critical issues or bugs that need to be addressed after launch, but our primary goal is to optimize Dawn of War for modern hardware.  

Q: [i][b]Does this mean that we’ll also get a new version of Dawn of War 2 or any other Relic Entertainment games?[/b][/i] 
A: We can only talk about games that we have announced. Right now, we’re focused on supporting the Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition and our other released and upcoming Relic games. 

Q: [i][b]When will you share more information about the updates and improvements to the game? [/b][/i]
A: Over the coming months we will have lots more to share from the development team in blogs, videos, and livestreams. Join the official [url=https://discord.gg/relicentertainment]Relic Entertainment Discord[/url] server to stay up to date on the latest.
